### deterministicReplayKey()

```ts
function deterministicReplayKey(domain, parts): Promise<ReplayKey>;
```

Derive one replay identity from a host-owned domain and ordered tuple. Callers
include the complete authority scope and stored command identity. JSON string
encoding preserves lone surrogates; byte-length frames prevent boundary shifts.
This encoding and its version remain stable across restarts.

#### Parameters

| --------- | ------------------- |
| `domain`  | `string`            |
| `parts`   | readonly `string`[] |
